attchmntText: Dynamatic Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Dynamatic Technologies Limited has intimated that an investor and analyst physical meeting is scheduled for Thursday, November 19, 2026, between 11:00 AM and 14:30 PM. The event will take place at JKM Plaza, Dynamatic Aerotropolis, 55, KIADB Aerospace Park, Bangalore 562149. Discussions will rely on publicly available information, with no unpublished price-sensitive information intended for discussion. The meeting is conducted in physical mode to showcase facilities. Recordings and transcripts will be uploaded to stock exchanges and the company website for remote participants. Investors must confirm their in-person participation on or before 16th November 2026 to Mr. Srinivas M K or Mr. Devaraj J. This information is filed under Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015, for scrip code 505242.

attchmntText: Dynamatic Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Dynamatic Technologies Limited filed a notice regarding the publication of newspaper advertisements for its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The advertisements were published in Business Standard and Sanjevani newspapers on 7th November 2026. The information is available on the company website at www.dynamatics.com. The document also contains financial extracts for PPAP Automotive Limited, Jana Holdings Limited, and Jana Capital Limited. PPAP Automotive Limited reported a net profit of 247.39 lakhs for the quarter ended 30th September 2026 and declared an interim dividend of Rs. 1.5 per equity share. Jana Holdings Limited reported a net loss of 65,014.21 thousand for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. Jana Capital Limited reported a net loss of 3,952.54 thousand for the quarter ended 30th September 2026.
